data.long_description:
Stunning 4-Bedroom + Maid’s Townhouse | Elie Saab – Vie at The Fields | Refined Living in MBR City, Dubai

Experience branded sophistication with this semi-furnished 4-bedroom townhouse at Elie Saab – Vie at The Fields, where architectural grace meets Dubai’s vibrant modernity.

This single-row, brand-new, and vacant townhouse spans a 2,774 sqft BUA on a 2,015 sqft plot, ideally positioned close to community amenities for ultimate convenience.

It features a smart, open layout, 5 bathrooms, built-in wardrobes, and private balconies—perfect for serene evenings and family gatherings.

Priced at AED 3,950,000, this residence embodies style, functionality, and long-term value.
Residents enjoy access to premium amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness centre, resort-style pools, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, all within a secure and elegant community developed by G&Co in collaboration with Elie Saab—a name synonymous with timeless craftsmanship.

Located in Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), Vie at The Fields offers excellent connectivity, family-friendly surroundings, and strong capital appreciation prospects.

Live the balance of elegance and comfort—contact Provident Real Estate LLC today to secure this exceptional townhouse.
